message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The task is almost complete. Alison has found a common slot and booked the meeting. My remaining task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

The agreed time is Thursday at 15:00. I need to make sure the email body is professional and contains all the necessary information. It should mention the date, time, and attendees of the meeting. The meeting is for 30 minutes.

The partners are Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor. I will send the email now. I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function.
The day is Thursday, the start time is 15:00. The body of the email should be clear and concise.
I will write a simple confirmation email.
"Dear Partners, This email confirms the booking of the partners' meeting for next week. The meeting is scheduled for Thursday, November 19, at 15:00 Eastern time for 30 minutes. The attendees are Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor."
This seems correct. I will proceed with sending the email.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
